subtopics.title: Evaluation Criteria Definition
subtopics.summary: Defining what to measure in AI systems, including domain-specific capabilities, generation capability, instruction-following capability, and cost and latency metrics.

subtopics.title: Evaluation Methods and Data Selection
subtopics.summary: Selecting appropriate evaluation methods such as toxicity classifiers, semantic similarity, and AI judges, along with annotating evaluation data and creating scoring rubrics with examples.

subtopics.title: Evaluation Pipeline Design
subtopics.summary: Designing the end-to-end evaluation pipeline including creating evaluation guidelines, evaluating all system components, tying metrics to business metrics, and iterating on the pipeline.

subtopics.title: Comparative vs Absolute Performance Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Understanding the differences between comparative performance evaluation (ranking models) and absolute performance evaluation, including challenges like lack of standardization and scalability bottlenecks.
